live_integration_summary.scope: Fresh live Ryu/Mininet/OVS validation run; only isolated Mininet bridges created by each test were modified.

tests.name: redundant_topology_baseline
tests.meaning: Redundant two-switch topology converged with one STP-blocked trunk and working host connectivity.

tests.name: paired_trunk_remediation_and_access_rejection
tests.meaning: Verified two-ended rule installation on standby trunk B (already STP-blocked), plus live rejection of an active-trunk block when its alternate is STP-blocked. Gate and executor both rejected the active-trunk request without flow changes; host connectivity remained intact. This is safe refusal, not automatic failover.

tests.name: two_switch_active_trunk_admin_down
tests.failure_injection: Mininet Linux interface ifconfig down; not proven to emit OpenFlow LINK_DOWN
tests.meaning: Active-trunk failure did not fail over; explicitly restoring the original link restored connectivity.

tests.name: three_switch_ring_active_route_admin_down
tests.failure_injection: ovs-ofctl mod-port administrative down; not a physical cable unplug
tests.meaning: The corrected host placement requires the alternate s1-s3-s2 route. Admin-down did not promote the STP-blocked direct link; restoring the trunk restored connectivity.

limitations: The live trunk-remediation pass blocks a standby trunk and validates paired rule installation, not active-link recovery.
The active-route fault injectors used Linux interface down or OpenFlow admin-down, not a physical cable unplug.
An attempt to emulate a physical unplug by deleting OVS bridge ports was blocked by remote safety controls and was not executed.
Automatic active-trunk failover remains unproven and must not be described as passed.
